thread:
jess: Heads-up: getting a cluster of customer reports about 5xx/timeouts hitting hosted API from us-west-2 since ~09:10 UTC. Pager shows 5xx rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~6%. Customer tickets 3421/3423. Anyone rolling anything?

maria: seeing the alerts. Investigating. Dashboards: https://internal.redwood/d/svc/api/gateway?orgId=1&from=now-1h . Spike aligns with a deploy at 09:08 (staged weight change).

aj: We have a canary->rollforward at 09:08 to push prefetch improvements. I think the canary weight was accidentally set to 100% in the staged script. Checking deploy logs...

sam: Confirmed — deploy history shows `staged-prefetch-rollforward` at 09:07 with param `prefetch_mode=aggressive`, weight=1.0 for staged. It should've been 0.1. That came from automation job `release-seed-14`.

leo: That prefetch change also adjusted KV cache TTL to 5s in the runtime. Aggressive prefetch + low TTL creates cache stampede under load — router returns 502/504 on backend timeouts.

maria: grabbing logs from gateway and model-router. Sample:
```
2025-10-11T09:09:12Z gateway WARN route=api model=llama-v2 error=upstream timeout
model-router timeout waiting for worker after 2000ms
```

aj: Repro steps to see locally: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' "https://api.redwood/v1/generate" -d '{"input":"ping"}'` — you will see 502s when traffic > ~200r/s against staged.

support-bot: automated incident runbook triggered: INC-2025-3421. Suggested actions: rollback flag OR reduce staged weight to 10%, throttle prefetch.

jess: Can we reduce staged weight to 10% and revert TTL to 120s? Let's coordinate rollback. @sam can you patch release job? We'll notify customers. :pray:

sam: I'm rolling staged weight back to 0.1 now. Command: 
```
releasectl set-weight --env=staged --feature=prefetch_mode --weight=0.1 --who=sam
```

leo: Also submitting hotfix to revert KV TTL change. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/789 — will roll out once CI passes.

maria: weight adjusted at 09:14 UTC. Monitoring... 5xx rate dropping from 6% -> 1.2% in last 3m.

aj: Auth queue backlog showed token validation lag, saw some 504s as secondary fallout. We'll watch token service queues.

jess: Messaging customers now with update and ETA. @support-bot post status to #customer-notifications. :loudspeaker:

support-bot: posted summary to #customer-notifications and updated INC-2025-3421 notes.

leo: hotfix merged and deploying to staged at 09:22. Observability note: watch model-router latency p95 and KV miss rate.

maria: Confirmed staged 5xx baseline back to ~0.15% at 09:30. Closing triage but keeping alert scope 1h.

jess: Thanks everyone. Postmortem owners: @leo (runtime fix), @sam (deploy automation), @aj (SRE follow-up). I'll open a support playbook entry. :white_check_mark:
